resources.string: This application is merely a tool to display usage statistics as returned by the Android system. It exists because there is no other way to get historical data from more than 10 days before the app was installed. \n\nUnfortunately, the implementation that provides this data is very buggy. For instance, the following bugs may be considered unfixable:
one application supposedly having been in the foreground for multiple days in a row
data for one ongoing period being the same as for another when it shouldn\'t
\"today\" starting at seemingly random points in time
getting less data at one attempt but not another
suddenly getting no data at all
For reliable and persistent data, please download usageDirect.
usageDirect provides reliable and persistent data.
Clock pie charts can be considered reliable. They use the same data source as usageDirect.
